note: Study skeleton paraphrased from the course scope (not verbatim College Board prose; unit numbers are our own sequencing, not official CED numbers). Skill codes are indicative: 1.x concept, 2.x/3.x skill.

objectives.statement: Explain what makes a research question original, focused, and feasible.
Refine a broad interest into a defensible research question.
Explain quantitative versus qualitative methods and their validity threats.
Select and justify a method appropriate to the question.
Explain the structure of a 4,000-5,000-word research paper.
Draft a paper with literature review, method, results, and discussion.
Explain how to present findings and anticipate examiner questions.
Defend choices of question, method, and interpretation orally.
Explain how feedback and limitations sections strengthen research.
Revise the paper in response to critique and document limitations.
